EventItemMinutesNote: There were three Public Comments received from the following: Genoveva Calloway; Shawn Ray, SPPEA and Eugene Kolosov, SPPEA.
EventItemActionText:
Received and Filed.

A motion was made by Councilmember Ponce, seconded by Councilmember Cruz, to receive and file Survey Results on Voter Support for Increasing Sales Tax. The Motion carried by the following vote:

                                    Aye: 5 - Cruz, Ponce, Pineda, Xavier, and Pabon-Alvarado

Adopted.

A motion was made by Councilmember Ponce, seconded by Councilmember Pineda, to adopt resolution to place the attached Transactions and Use (Sales) tax measure (Ordinance) on the November 3, 2026 election ballot. The Motion carried by the following vote:

                                    Aye: 5 - Cruz, Ponce, Pineda, Xavier, and Pabon-Alvarado
EventItemTitle: CONSIDER RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN PABLO PLACING A PROPOSED MEASURE ON THE NOVEMBER 3, 2026 BALLOT SEEKING VOTER APPROVAL OF A GENERAL TEN-YEAR TRANSACTIONS AND USE (SALES) TAX WITH FIVE YEARS AT ONE-HALF OF ONE PERCENT (0.50%), REDUCING TO ONE-QUARTER OF ONE PERCENT (0.25%) FOR THE NEXT FIVE YEARS, THEN TERMINATING ALTOGETHER, TO FUND GENERAL MUNICIPAL SERVICES; AND REQUESTING THAT CONTRA COSTA COUNTY CONSOLIDATE THIS ELECTION WITH THE STATEWIDE ELECTION SET TO OCCUR ON THE SAME DATE
